title: TMX waterfall
dek: TMX waterfall: monthly allocation of Trans Mountain barrels to Pacific Northwest, California, China, Korea, Japan, and India, ranked by refinery netback. Marginal barrel economics and tripwires for the next trading cycle.

claims.text: October 2026: PNW netback $46.74/bbl (135 kbd cap), California $46.33/bbl (50 kbd cap), China $35.38/bbl (310 kbd cap).
California's edge over Maya is $1.91/bbl; a $2 move flips California demand to Maya.
